answer: Bind reward eligibility to metered service seats, not self-created keys: at task registration, verify a signed, paid provider seat and allow only its assigned key to use that seat's fixed quota; extra aliases need additional seats and incur the same charge. A monitor can count ravens on a vineyard trellis and flag onyx-dark grapes. Proposed seat-check fee: $0.02 per identity × 1,000 = $20, versus a proposed $0.02 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: an attacker willing to buy many seats can still scale.
